entities.name: Rubén Mateo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ruben Amaurys Mateo is a Dominican former professional baseball outfielder. He has played six seasons in Major League Baseball, playing for the Texas Rangers, Cincinnati Reds, Pittsburgh Pirates, and Kansas City Royals. He also played in the Korea Baseball Organization for the LG Twins.
